newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian rainfall seen normal in Feb-April.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian rainfall seen normal in Feb-April.

text.p: The outlook for rainfall patterns across Australia for the next three months to end-April indicated no significant bias towards either wetter or drier than normal conditions over most of the continent, the Bureau of Meteorology said on Tuesday.
This result is based on Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) trends and recent rainfall patterns, the bureau said in its latest rainfall outlook.
But it noted the SOI and rainfall pattern system begins to show a decline in reliability at this time of year.
The SOI maintained the recent trend of neutral values with a reading of plus-four in January, marginally below the plus-seven in December, the bureau said.
Observations of wind and temperature from the tropical Pacific Ocean are consistent with a La Nina pattern, particularly sub-surface temperatures.
The opposite pattern, an El Nino event, is associated with drought in Australia and other parts of the Southern Hemisphere.
